import re, unicodedata
import pandas as pd, numpy as np

def _h_norm(s):
    s = str(s).lower().replace('đ', 'd')
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFD', s).encode('ascii', 'ignore').decode()
    return re.sub('\\s+', ' ', s).strip()

def _h_money(s):
    if isinstance(s, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) and (not isinstance(s, bool)):
        return float(s)
    s = str(s).strip().lower().replace('đ', '').replace('₫', '')
    if not s or s in ('nan', 'none'):
        return np.nan
    s = s.replace(' ', '')
    if 'tr' in s:
        (left, right) = s.split('tr', 1)
        try:
            base = float(left.replace(',', '.')) if left else 0.0
        except Exception:
            return np.nan
        extra = 0.0
        if right:
            try:
                extra = float(right) * 1000.0
            except Exception:
                extra = 0.0
        return base * 1000000.0 + extra
    if s.endswith('k'):
        try:
            return float(s[:-1].replace(',', '.')) * 1000.0
        except Exception:
            return np.nan
    s = re.sub('[^0-9.\\-]', '', s.replace(',', ''))
    if s in ('', '-', '.'):
        return np.nan
    try:
        return float(s.replace('.', ''))
    except Exception:
        return np.nan

def _h_qty_num(s):
    if isinstance(s, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) and (not isinstance(s, bool)):
        return float(s)
    m = re.search('-?\\d+(?:[.,]\\d+)?', str(s))
    if not m:
        return np.nan
    v = m.group().replace(',', '.')
    try:
        return float(v)
    except Exception:
        return np.nan

def _h_dates(col):
    s = pd.Series(col)
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(s):
        return s
    out = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=s.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
    num = pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')
    mask = num.notna() & (num > 1000) & (num < 100000)
    if mask.any():
        out.loc[mask] = pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.to_timedelta(num.loc[mask], unit='D')
    rest = s.notna() & ~mask
    if rest.any():
        t = s.loc[rest].astype(str).str.strip()
        t = t.str.replace('\\s*thg\\s*', '/', regex=True)
        parts = t.str.extract('^(\\d{1,4})[-/](\\d{1,2})[-/](\\d{1,4})')
        parsed = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=t.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
        okp = parts.notna().all(axis=1)
        if okp.any():
            (a, bb, c) = (parts.loc[okp, 0], parts.loc[okp, 1], parts.loc[okp, 2])
            year = c.where(c.str.len() == 4, a)
            month = bb
            day = a.where(c.str.len() == 4, c)
            parsed.loc[okp] = pd.to_datetime(pd.DataFrame({'year': year.astype(int), 'month': month.astype(int), 'day': day.astype(int)}), errors='coerce')
        if (~okp).any():
            parsed.loc[~okp] = pd.to_datetime(t.loc[~okp], errors='coerce', dayfirst=True)
        out.loc[rest] = parsed
    return out

import re, unicodedata
import pandas as pd, numpy as np

def _h_norm(s):
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFD', str(s)).encode('ascii', 'ignore').decode().lower()
    return re.sub('\\s+', ' ', s).strip()

def _h_money(s):
    """Parse Vietnamese money values. Handles '240,000', '45k', '1tr440', '1,45tr', 240000."""
    if isinstance(s, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) and (not isinstance(s, bool)):
        return float(s)
    s = str(s).strip().lower().replace('đ', '').replace('₫', '')
    if not s or s in ('nan', 'none'):
        return np.nan
    s = s.replace(' ', '')
    mult = 1.0
    if 'tr' in s:
        mult = 1000000.0
        s = s.replace('tr', '')
        if ',' in s and '.' not in s:
            s = s.replace(',', '.')
        s = s.replace(',', '')
    elif s.endswith('k'):
        mult = 1000.0
        s = s[:-1]
        if ',' in s and '.' not in s:
            s = s.replace(',', '.')
        s = s.replace(',', '')
    else:
        s = s.replace(',', '').replace('.', '') if s.count('.') > 0 and s.count(',') > 0 else s.replace(',', '')
    s = re.sub('[^0-9.\\-]', '', s)
    if s in ('', '-', '.'):
        return np.nan
    try:
        return float(s) * mult
    except Exception:
        return np.nan

def _h_mnum(col):
    return pd.Series(col).map(_h_money)

def _h_dates(col):
    s = pd.Series(col)
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(s):
        return s
    out = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=s.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
    num = pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')
    mask = num.notna() & (num > 1000) & (num < 100000)
    if mask.any():
        out.loc[mask] = pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.to_timedelta(num.loc[mask], unit='D')
    rest = s.notna() & ~mask
    if rest.any():
        t = s.loc[rest].astype(str).str.strip()
        iso = t.str.match('^\\d{4}-\\d{1,2}-\\d{1,2}', na=False)
        parsed = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=t.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
        if iso.any():
            parsed.loc[iso] = pd.to_datetime(t.loc[iso], errors='coerce')
        other = ~iso
        if other.any():
            parsed.loc[other] = pd.to_datetime(t.loc[other], errors='coerce', dayfirst=True)
        out.loc[rest] = parsed
    return out

import re, unicodedata
import pandas as pd, numpy as np

def _h_norm(s):
    s = str(s).lower().replace('đ', 'd')
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFD', s).encode('ascii', 'ignore').decode()
    return re.sub('\\s+', ' ', s).strip()

def _h_money(s):
    if isinstance(s, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) and (not isinstance(s, bool)):
        return float(s)
    s = str(s).strip().lower().replace('đ', '').replace('₫', '')
    if not s or s in ('nan', 'none'):
        return np.nan
    s = s.replace(' ', '')
    if 'tr' in s:
        (left, right) = s.split('tr', 1)
        try:
            base = float(left.replace(',', '.')) if left else 0.0
        except Exception:
            return np.nan
        extra = 0.0
        if right:
            try:
                extra = float(right) * 1000.0
            except Exception:
                extra = 0.0
        return base * 1000000.0 + extra
    if s.endswith('k'):
        try:
            return float(s[:-1].replace(',', '.')) * 1000.0
        except Exception:
            return np.nan
    s = re.sub('[^0-9.\\-]', '', s.replace(',', ''))
    if s in ('', '-', '.'):
        return np.nan
    try:
        return float(s.replace('.', ''))
    except Exception:
        return np.nan

def _h_qty_num(s):
    if isinstance(s, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) and (not isinstance(s, bool)):
        return float(s)
    m = re.search('-?\\d+(?:[.,]\\d+)?', str(s))
    if not m:
        return np.nan
    v = m.group().replace(',', '.')
    try:
        return float(v)
    except Exception:
        return np.nan

def _h_dates(col):
    s = pd.Series(col)
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(s):
        return s
    out = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=s.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
    num = pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')
    mask = num.notna() & (num > 1000) & (num < 100000)
    if mask.any():
        out.loc[mask] = pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.to_timedelta(num.loc[mask], unit='D')
    rest = s.notna() & ~mask
    if rest.any():
        t = s.loc[rest].astype(str).str.strip()
        t = t.str.replace('\\s*thg\\s*', '/', regex=True)
        parts = t.str.extract('^(\\d{1,4})[-/](\\d{1,2})[-/](\\d{1,4})')
        parsed = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=t.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
        okp = parts.notna().all(axis=1)
        if okp.any():
            (a, bb, c) = (parts.loc[okp, 0], parts.loc[okp, 1], parts.loc[okp, 2])
            year = c.where(c.str.len() == 4, a)
            month = bb
            day = a.where(c.str.len() == 4, c)
            parsed.loc[okp] = pd.to_datetime(pd.DataFrame({'year': year.astype(int), 'month': month.astype(int), 'day': day.astype(int)}), errors='coerce')
        if (~okp).any():
            parsed.loc[~okp] = pd.to_datetime(t.loc[~okp], errors='coerce', dayfirst=True)
        out.loc[rest] = parsed
    return out

def _h_money(x):

    s = str(x).strip().lower().replace('đ', '').replace(' ', '')
    mult = 1.0
    if s.endswith('tr'):
        s = s[:-2].replace(',', '.')
        mult = 1000000.0
    elif s.endswith('k'):
        s = s[:-1].replace('.', '').replace(',', '.')

    try:

    if isinstance(x, (int, float)) and (not isinstance(x, bool)):
        return pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.Timedelta(days=float(x))
    if isinstance(x, str) and re.match('^\\s*\\d{5}(\\.0+)?\\s*$', x):
        return pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.Timedelta(days=float(x))
    d = pd.to_datetime(x, errors='coerce', dayfirst=True)
    if pd.isna(d):
        m = re.match('^\\s*(\\d{1,2})\\s*thg\\s*(\\d{1,2})\\s*(\\d{4})\\s*$', str(x), re.I)
        if m:
            try:
                d = pd.Timestamp(int(m.group(3)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(1)))
            except Exception:
                d = pd.NaT
    if pd.isna(d):

        mult = 1000000.0
    elif s.endswith('k'):
        s = s[:-1].replace('.', '').replace(',', '.')

def _h_to_date(x):
    if isinstance(x, (int, float)) and (not isinstance(x, bool)):
        return pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.Timedelta(days=float(x))
    if isinstance(x, str) and re.match('^\\s*\\d{5}(\\.0+)?\\s*$', x):
        return pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.Timedelta(days=float(x))
    d = pd.to_datetime(x, errors='coerce', dayfirst=True)
    if pd.isna(d):
        m = re.match('^\\s*(\\d{1,2})\\s*thg\\s*(\\d{1,2})\\s*(\\d{4})\\s*$', str(x), re.I)
        if m:
            try:
                d = pd.Timestamp(int(m.group(3)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(1)))
            except Exception:
                d = pd.NaT
    if pd.isna(d):
        try:
            d = pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.Timedelta(days=float(x))
        except Exception:
            pass
    return d

import re, unicodedata

def _h_norm(s):

    if isinstance(s, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) and (not isinstance(s, bool)):
        return float(s)
    s = str(s).strip().lower().replace('đ', '').replace('₫', '')
    if not s or s in ('nan', 'none'):
        return np.nan
    s = s.replace(' ', '')
    if 'tr' in s:
        (left, right) = s.split('tr', 1)
        try:
            base = float(left.replace(',', '.')) if left else 0.0
        except Exception:
            return np.nan
        extra = 0.0
        if right:
            try:
                extra = float(right) * 1000.0
            except Exception:
                extra = 0.0
        return base * 1000000.0 + extra
    if s.endswith('k'):
        try:
            return float(s[:-1].replace(',', '.')) * 1000.0
        except Exception:
            return np.nan
    s = re.sub('[^0-9.\\-]', '', s.replace(',', ''))
    if s in ('', '-', '.'):
        return np.nan
    try:
        return float(s.replace('.', ''))
    except Exception:
        return np.nan

def _h_qty_num(s):
    if isinstance(s, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) and (not isinstance(s, bool)):
        return float(s)
    m = re.search('-?\\d+(?:[.,]\\d+)?', str(s))
    if not m:
        return np.nan
    v = m.group().replace(',', '.')
    try:
        return float(v)
    except Exception:
        return np.nan

def _h_dates(col):
    s = pd.Series(col)
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(s):
        return s
    out = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=s.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
    num = pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')
    mask = num.notna() & (num > 1000) & (num < 100000)
    if mask.any():
        out.loc[mask] = pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.to_timedelta(num.loc[mask], unit='D')
    rest = s.notna() & ~mask
    if rest.any():
        t = s.loc[rest].astype(str).str.strip()
        t = t.str.replace('\\s*thg\\s*', '/', regex=True)
        parts = t.str.extract('^(\\d{1,4})[-/](\\d{1,2})[-/](\\d{1,4})')
        parsed = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=t.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
        okp = parts.notna().all(axis=1)
        if okp.any():
            (a, bb, c) = (parts.loc[okp, 0], parts.loc[okp, 1], parts.loc[okp, 2])
            year = c.where(c.str.len() == 4, a)
            month = bb
            day = a.where(c.str.len() == 4, c)
            parsed.loc[okp] = pd.to_datetime(pd.DataFrame({'year': year.astype(int), 'month': month.astype(int), 'day': day.astype(int)}), errors='coerce')
        if (~okp).any():
            parsed.loc[~okp] = pd.to_datetime(t.loc[~okp], errors='coerce', dayfirst=True)
        out.loc[rest] = parsed
    return out

def _h_money(s):
    """Parse Vietnamese money values. Handles '240,000', '45k', '1tr440', '1,45tr', 240000."""
    if isinstance(s, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) and (not isinstance(s, bool)):
        return float(s)
    s = str(s).strip().lower().replace('đ', '').replace('₫', '')
    if not s or s in ('nan', 'none'):
        return np.nan
    s = s.replace(' ', '')
    mult = 1.0
    if 'tr' in s:
        mult = 1000000.0
        s = s.replace('tr', '')
        if ',' in s and '.' not in s:
            s = s.replace(',', '.')
        s = s.replace(',', '')
    elif s.endswith('k'):
        mult = 1000.0
        s = s[:-1]
        if ',' in s and '.' not in s:
            s = s.replace(',', '.')
        s = s.replace(',', '')
    else:
        s = s.replace(',', '').replace('.', '') if s.count('.') > 0 and s.count(',') > 0 else s.replace(',', '')
    s = re.sub('[^0-9.\\-]', '', s)
    if s in ('', '-', '.'):
        return np.nan
    try:
        return float(s) * mult
    except Exception:
        return np.nan

def _h_mnum(col):

def _h_dates(col):
    s = pd.Series(col)
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(s):
        return s
    out = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=s.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
    num = pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')
    mask = num.notna() & (num > 1000) & (num < 100000)
    if mask.any():
        out.loc[mask] = pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.to_timedelta(num.loc[mask], unit='D')
    rest = s.notna() & ~mask
    if rest.any():
        t = s.loc[rest].astype(str).str.strip()
        iso = t.str.match('^\\d{4}-\\d{1,2}-\\d{1,2}', na=False)
        parsed = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=t.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
        if iso.any():
            parsed.loc[iso] = pd.to_datetime(t.loc[iso], errors='coerce')
        other = ~iso
        if other.any():
            parsed.loc[other] = pd.to_datetime(t.loc[other], errors='coerce', dayfirst=True)
        out.loc[rest] = parsed
    return out

import re, unicodedata
import pandas as pd, numpy as np

def _h_norm(s):
    s = str(s).lower().replace('đ', 'd')
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFD', s).encode('ascii', 'ignore').decode()
    return re.sub('\\s+', ' ', s).strip()

def _h_money(s):
    if isinstance(s, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) and (not isinstance(s, bool)):
        return float(s)
    s = str(s).strip().lower().replace('đ', '').replace('₫', '')
    if not s or s in ('nan', 'none'):
        return np.nan
    s = s.replace(' ', '')
    if 'tr' in s:
        (left, right) = s.split('tr', 1)
        try:
            base = float(left.replace(',', '.')) if left else 0.0
        except Exception:
            return np.nan
        extra = 0.0
        if right:
            try:
                extra = float(right) * 1000.0
            except Exception:
                extra = 0.0
        return base * 1000000.0 + extra
    if s.endswith('k'):
        try:
            return float(s[:-1].replace(',', '.')) * 1000.0
        except Exception:
            return np.nan
    s = re.sub('[^0-9.\\-]', '', s.replace(',', ''))
    if s in ('', '-', '.'):
        return np.nan
    try:
        return float(s.replace('.', ''))
    except Exception:
        return np.nan

def _h_qty_num(s):
    if isinstance(s, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) and (not isinstance(s, bool)):
        return float(s)
    m = re.search('-?\\d+(?:[.,]\\d+)?', str(s))
    if not m:
        return np.nan
    v = m.group().replace(',', '.')
    try:
        return float(v)
    except Exception:
        return np.nan

def _h_dates(col):
    s = pd.Series(col)
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(s):
        return s
    out = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=s.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
    num = pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')
    mask = num.notna() & (num > 1000) & (num < 100000)
    if mask.any():
        out.loc[mask] = pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.to_timedelta(num.loc[mask], unit='D')
    rest = s.notna() & ~mask
    if rest.any():
        t = s.loc[rest].astype(str).str.strip()
        t = t.str.replace('\\s*thg\\s*', '/', regex=True)
        parts = t.str.extract('^(\\d{1,4})[-/](\\d{1,2})[-/](\\d{1,4})')
        parsed = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=t.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
        okp = parts.notna().all(axis=1)
        if okp.any():
            (a, bb, c) = (parts.loc[okp, 0], parts.loc[okp, 1], parts.loc[okp, 2])
            year = c.where(c.str.len() == 4, a)
            month = bb
            day = a.where(c.str.len() == 4, c)
            parsed.loc[okp] = pd.to_datetime(pd.DataFrame({'year': year.astype(int), 'month': month.astype(int), 'day': day.astype(int)}), errors='coerce')
        if (~okp).any():
            parsed.loc[~okp] = pd.to_datetime(t.loc[~okp], errors='coerce', dayfirst=True)
        out.loc[rest] = parsed
    return out

    if not s or s in ('nan', 'none'):

    s = s.replace(' ', '')

        except Exception:

        extra = 0.0
        if right:

    rest = s.notna() & ~mask

import re, unicodedata
import pandas as pd, numpy as np

def _h_norm(s):
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFD', str(s)).encode('ascii', 'ignore').decode().lower()
    return re.sub('\\s+', ' ', s).strip()

def _h_money(s):
    """Parse Vietnamese money values. Handles '240,000', '45k', '1tr440', '1,45tr', 240000."""
    if isinstance(s, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) and (not isinstance(s, bool)):
        return float(s)
    s = str(s).strip().lower().replace('đ', '').replace('₫', '')
    if not s or s in ('nan', 'none'):
        return np.nan
    s = s.replace(' ', '')
    mult = 1.0
    if 'tr' in s:
        mult = 1000000.0
        s = s.replace('tr', '')
        if ',' in s and '.' not in s:
            s = s.replace(',', '.')
        s = s.replace(',', '')
    elif s.endswith('k'):
        mult = 1000.0
        s = s[:-1]
        if ',' in s and '.' not in s:
            s = s.replace(',', '.')
        s = s.replace(',', '')
    else:
        s = s.replace(',', '').replace('.', '') if s.count('.') > 0 and s.count(',') > 0 else s.replace(',', '')
    s = re.sub('[^0-9.\\-]', '', s)
    if s in ('', '-', '.'):
        return np.nan
    try:
        return float(s) * mult
    except Exception:
        return np.nan

def _h_mnum(col):
    return pd.Series(col).map(_h_money)

def _h_dates(col):
    s = pd.Series(col)
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(s):
        return s
    out = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=s.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
    num = pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')
    mask = num.notna() & (num > 1000) & (num < 100000)
    if mask.any():
        out.loc[mask] = pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.to_timedelta(num.loc[mask], unit='D')
    rest = s.notna() & ~mask
    if rest.any():
        t = s.loc[rest].astype(str).str.strip()
        iso = t.str.match('^\\d{4}-\\d{1,2}-\\d{1,2}', na=False)
        parsed = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=t.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
        if iso.any():
            parsed.loc[iso] = pd.to_datetime(t.loc[iso], errors='coerce')
        other = ~iso
        if other.any():
            parsed.loc[other] = pd.to_datetime(t.loc[other], errors='coerce', dayfirst=True)
        out.loc[rest] = parsed
    return out

import re, unicodedata
import pandas as pd, numpy as np

def _h_norm(s):
    s = str(s).lower().replace('đ', 'd')
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFD', s).encode('ascii', 'ignore').decode()
    return re.sub('\\s+', ' ', s).strip()

def _h_money(s):
    if isinstance(s, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) and (not isinstance(s, bool)):
        return float(s)
    s = str(s).strip().lower().replace('đ', '').replace('₫', '')
    if not s or s in ('nan', 'none'):
        return np.nan
    s = s.replace(' ', '')
    if 'tr' in s:
        (left, right) = s.split('tr', 1)
        try:
            base = float(left.replace(',', '.')) if left else 0.0
        except Exception:
            return np.nan
        extra = 0.0
        if right:
            try:
                extra = float(right) * 1000.0
            except Exception:
                extra = 0.0
        return base * 1000000.0 + extra
    if s.endswith('k'):
        try:
            return float(s[:-1].replace(',', '.')) * 1000.0
        except Exception:
            return np.nan
    s = re.sub('[^0-9.\\-]', '', s.replace(',', ''))
    if s in ('', '-', '.'):
        return np.nan
    try:
        return float(s.replace('.', ''))
    except Exception:
        return np.nan

    if isinstance(s, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) and (not isinstance(s, bool)):
        return float(s)
    m = re.search('-?\\d+(?:[.,]\\d+)?', str(s))
    if not m:
        return np.nan
    v = m.group().replace(',', '.')
    try:
        return float(v)
    except Exception:
        return np.nan

    s = pd.Series(col)
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(s):
        return s
    out = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=s.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
    num = pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')
    mask = num.notna() & (num > 1000) & (num < 100000)
    if mask.any():
        out.loc[mask] = pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.to_timedelta(num.loc[mask], unit='D')
    rest = s.notna() & ~mask
    if rest.any():
        t = s.loc[rest].astype(str).str.strip()
        t = t.str.replace('\\s*thg\\s*', '/', regex=True)
        parts = t.str.extract('^(\\d{1,4})[-/](\\d{1,2})[-/](\\d{1,4})')
        parsed = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=t.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
        okp = parts.notna().all(axis=1)
        if okp.any():
            (a, bb, c) = (parts.loc[okp, 0], parts.loc[okp, 1], parts.loc[okp, 2])
            year = c.where(c.str.len() == 4, a)
            month = bb
            day = a.where(c.str.len() == 4, c)
            parsed.loc[okp] = pd.to_datetime(pd.DataFrame({'year': year.astype(int), 'month': month.astype(int), 'day': day.astype(int)}), errors='coerce')
        if (~okp).any():
            parsed.loc[~okp] = pd.to_datetime(t.loc[~okp], errors='coerce', dayfirst=True)
        out.loc[rest] = parsed
    return out

def _h_qty_num(s):

    if not m:

    except Exception:

def _h_dates(col):
    s = pd.Series(col)
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(s):
        return s
    out = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=s.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
    num = pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')
    mask = num.notna() & (num > 1000) & (num < 100000)
    if mask.any():
        out.loc[mask] = pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.to_timedelta(num.loc[mask], unit='D')
    rest = s.notna() & ~mask
    if rest.any():
        t = s.loc[rest].astype(str).str.strip()
        t = t.str.replace('\\s*thg\\s*', '/', regex=True)
        parts = t.str.extract('^(\\d{1,4})[-/](\\d{1,2})[-/](\\d{1,4})')
        parsed = pd.Series(pd.NaT, index=t.index, dtype='datetime64[ns]')
        okp = parts.notna().all(axis=1)
        if okp.any():
            (a, bb, c) = (parts.loc[okp, 0], parts.loc[okp, 1], parts.loc[okp, 2])
            year = c.where(c.str.len() == 4, a)
            month = bb
            day = a.where(c.str.len() == 4, c)
            parsed.loc[okp] = pd.to_datetime(pd.DataFrame({'year': year.astype(int), 'month': month.astype(int), 'day': day.astype(int)}), errors='coerce')
        if (~okp).any():
            parsed.loc[~okp] = pd.to_datetime(t.loc[~okp], errors='coerce', dayfirst=True)
        out.loc[rest] = parsed
    return out

        return pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.Timedelta(days=float(x))
    d = pd.to_datetime(x, errors='coerce', dayfirst=True)
    if pd.isna(d):
        m = re.match('^\\s*(\\d{1,2})\\s*thg\\s*(\\d{1,2})\\s*(\\d{4})\\s*$', str(x), re.I)
        if m:
            try:
                d = pd.Timestamp(int(m.group(3)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(1)))
            except Exception:
                d = pd.NaT
    if pd.isna(d):
